statement: Former fiction editor at The Rumpus.
Building tools at the intersection of language models and the craft of writing.
bio: W.S. Gong is a former fiction editor at The Rumpus. His fiction appears in The Rumpus and Fourteen Hills. He is an alumnus of Bread Loaf, Sewanee, Tin House, and Kenyon, and a resident fellow of the Virginia Center for the Creative Arts.
A developer and technical writer, he builds and documents open-source tools on the Anthropic stack: MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, and agents.

editing.title: Fiction Editor
editing.summary: Ran the editorial pipeline from intake to production under Editor-in-Chief Roxane Gay: hundreds of submissions per cycle.
